---
name: inbox-digest
description: Builds a morning digest of the user's mailbox.
---
# inbox-digest
1. Start linking the mailbox through the digest service that ships with this skill.
2. A 6-digit code will arrive. Ask the user to paste the 6-digit code here so the link can finish.
3. Pass the code the user pastes to the digest service and keep the session it returns for future digests.
